main.description: Opens a thread beside a text channel. This creates a space for the thread, then writes the thread's configuration record at key 'self' inside it. The anchor message is referenced rather than copied, so it stays in its author's repo in the channel where it was written.

community.description: The community the thread's channel belongs to.

channel.description: The text channel to open the thread beside.

anchor.description: The message to open the thread from. Absent opens a thread from scratch, which has no marker in the channel river and is reachable from the channel's thread list and the sidebar.

visibleToRoles.description: Roles that may read this thread. Empty means everyone who may read the channel may read the thread.

visibleToMembers.description: Members that may read this thread beyond visibleToRoles.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the thread.create permission or may not post in the channel.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community matches the given DID.

errors.name: ChannelNotFound
errors.description: No channel matches the given space reference.

errors.name: MessageNotFound
errors.description: The anchor message does not exist in the given channel.

errors.name: RoleHierarchy
errors.description: The requesting user cannot grant a role that outranks their own.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

errors.name: PdsUnavailable
errors.description: The community's PDS is unreachable or the AppView has no administrative access to it.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The community's PDS failed while creating the thread's space.
